The Low Footprint profile is currently not supported.

fx_standalone.title: Operating system
fx_standalone.description: When set to 'No_OS', FileX runs in standalone mode. Conversely, when set to 'FreeRTOS', FileX operates within a FreeRTOS environment. To enable and use this option, the FreeRTOS middleware must be activated in the project.

actions.message: Enable the FreeRTOS middleware to select this operating system.

fx_disable_error_checking.title: Error checking behavior
fx_disable_error_checking.description: Removes the config FileX error checking API, resulting in improved performance (up to 30%) and smaller code size.

fx_fat_map_size.title: Number of sectors for FAT
fx_fat_map_size.description: Specifies the number of sectors that can be represented in the FAT update map. Larger values help reduce unneeded updates of secondary FAT sectors.

fx_max_fat_cache.title: Maximum number of FAT cache entries
fx_max_fat_cache.description: Specifies the size of the FAT cache used by FileX for this media. A higher value allows more FAT entries to be cached, which can reduce FAT access overhead and improve file system performance, at the cost of increased memory usage.

fx_max_long_name_len.title: Maximum length of long file names
fx_max_long_name_len.description: Specifies the upper limit for the length of long file names that FileX can handle on this media.

fx_max_sector_cache.title: Maximum number of cached sectors
fx_max_sector_cache.description: The cache buffer provided to FileX in the `fx_media_open()` API determines how many sectors can actually be cached.

fx_update_rate_in_seconds.title: Time update interval in seconds
fx_update_rate_in_seconds.description: Controls the period used by FileX to perform its internal periodic maintenance tasks on this media. The value is expressed in seconds and determines how often these background operations are executed.

fx_update_rate_in_ticks.title: Time update interval in RTOS ticks
fx_update_rate_in_ticks.description: Specifies the number of RTOS ticks between two consecutive FileX periodic maintenance operations on this media. This value controls how frequently these background tasks are executed within an RTOS-based configuration.

fx_disable_cache.title: File system cache usage
fx_disable_cache.description: When this parameter is set to true, the file system does not use a cache for storage access. All read and write operations are performed directly on the mass storage, which may reduce performance but limits RAM usage.

fx_no_local_path.title: Local path support
fx_no_local_path.description: When enabled, local path support is disabled.

fx_single_thread.title: Single-thread mode
fx_single_thread.description: Eliminates FreeRTOS protection logic from the FileX source. Use if FileX is being used only from one thread or without FreeRTOS.

fx_disable_direct_data_read_cache_fill.title: Direct data read cache fill
fx_disable_direct_data_read_cache_fill.description: If enabled, the direct read sector update of cache is disabled.

fx_dont_update_open_files.title: Don't update open files
fx_dont_update_open_files.description: If enabled, FileX does not update already opened files.

fx_driver_use_64bit_lba.title: Use 64-bit LBA in driver
fx_driver_use_64bit_lba.description: If enabled, 64-bit sector addresses are used in the I/O driver.

fx_max_last_name_len.title: Maximum file name length
fx_max_last_name_len.description: Defines the maximum file name length, including the full path name. Must be as large or larger than Max Long Name Length.

fx_rename_path_inherit.title: Inherit path on rename
fx_rename_path_inherit.description: Controls whether the new path inherits attributes from the original path during a rename operation. When enabled, FileX preserves directory path information and associated attributes when a file or directory is renamed.

fx_single_open_legacy.title: Legacy single open
fx_single_open_legacy.description: When set to true, FileX prevents multiple concurrent opens of the same file.

fx_disable_file_close.title: File close operation
fx_disable_file_close.description: When set to true, calls to close a file are ignored and the file remains logically open inside FileX. This is intended for very specific debugging or integration scenarios.

fx_disable_fast_open.title: Fast file opening
fx_disable_fast_open.description: When set to true, the fast open optimization is disabled. FileX then performs a full directory search for each file open, which can simplify behavior but may reduce performance.

fx_disable_force_memory_operation.title: Forced memory operations
fx_disable_force_memory_operation.description: When set to true, FileX skips certain forced memory operations (such as explicit flushes or cache updates) in critical paths. This can slightly reduce overhead but may impact robustness in corner cases.

fx_disable_build_options.title: Build options usage
fx_disable_build_options.description: When set to true, FileX build option strings and related metadata are not compiled in. This reduces code size but removes this diagnostic information at runtime.

fx_disable_one_line_function.title: Single-line functions
fx_disable_one_line_function.description: When set to true, small one-line wrapper functions are not used. This can make debugging stack traces more explicit, at the cost of slightly larger call sites.

fx_disable_fat_entry_refresh.title: FAT entry refresh
fx_disable_fat_entry_refresh.description: When set to true, automatic refresh of FAT entries in memory is reduced or skipped. This lowers overhead but can delay the visibility of FAT changes made by other components.

fx_disable_consecutive_detect.title: Consecutive sector detection
fx_disable_consecutive_detect.description: When set to true, FileX no longer tries to detect and group consecutive sectors into larger transfers. This simplifies driver behavior but may decrease I/O throughput.

fx_media_statistics_disable.title: Media statistics collection
fx_media_statistics_disable.description: When set to true, FileX does not collect media statistics such as operation counters. This reduces runtime overhead and memory usage, but removes useful diagnostic data.

fx_media_disable_search_cache.title: File search cache
fx_media_disable_search_cache.description: When set to true, the internal cache used to speed up file and directory searches is disabled. Every lookup then performs a full directory scan, which can simplify behavior but impact performance.

fx_no_timer.title: Timer updates
fx_no_timer.description: When set to true, FileX does not update time and date information for files and directories from a system timer. Timestamps remain static or must be handled by the application.

fx_enable_fault_tolerant.title: Fault tolerance service
fx_enable_fault_tolerant.description:
Enables the FileX fault-tolerant service. This parameter can only be activated if the following conditions are met:

- The project uses NOR or NAND flash memory
- NOR flash or NAND flash support is activated in the LevelX middleware
- The corresponding NOR or NAND interface is added to FileX

When enabled, FileX provides mechanisms to recover from unexpected power loss or data corruption, ensuring file system integrity.

actions.message: Add a NOR or NAND FileX interface to activate fault tolerance service.

fx_fault_tolerant.title: Immediate system sector writes
fx_fault_tolerant.description: If enabled, system sector write requests (including FAT and directory entry requests) are flushed immediately to the driver.

actions.message: Enable the Fault tolerance service to configure this parameter.

fx_fault_tolerant_data.title: Data flush on write requests
fx_fault_tolerant_data.description: If enabled, data sector write requests are flushed immediately to the driver.

actions.message: Enable the Fault tolerance service to configure this parameter.

interface_type.title: Interface
interface_type.description:
Choose the type of memory interface to be used for this configuration.

The available options depend on the hardware and middleware setup in your project.

Activation conditions for each interface:
- SD: requires SDMMC enabled and configured in SD mode.
- MMC: requires SDMMC enabled and configured in MMC mode.
- NOR: requires LevelX middleware with NOR flash support enabled.
- NAND: requires LevelX middleware with NAND flash support enabled.

Selecting the correct interface ensures proper communication between FileX and the underlying memory hardware. If no compatible interface is detected, this parameter will be disabled.

actions.message: Enable the SDMMC IP and configure in SD mode to select this interface.
Enable the SDMMC IP and configure in MMC mode to select this interface.

interface_mode.title: Interface mode
interface_mode.description: Select the interface mode used for SD or MMC communication. The available options depend on the selected interface type. 'DMA OS' or 'POLLING' modes requires FreeRTOS to be enabled and FileX to be configured in RTOS mode. When using the "DMA OS" mode with FreeRTOS, configure the NVIC interrupt priority of the SDMMC IP to a numerical value greater than FreeRTOS configLIBRARY_MAX_SYSCALL_INTERRUPT_PRIORITY flag value.

actions.message: Enable FreeRTOS to activate this feature

filex_sd_flag_none.title: Disactivate all SD flags
filex_sd_flag_none.description: Disable all special flags for the SD card operations. This is the default state with no additional features enabled.

filex_sd_flag_cache_maintenance.title: Cache maintenance
filex_sd_flag_cache_maintenance.description: Enable cache maintenance operations for the SD card. This helps in ensuring data consistency and performance.

actions.message: Clear 'Disactivate all SD flags' to configure individual SD flags.

filex_sd_flag_scratch_buffer.title: Scratch buffer
filex_sd_flag_scratch_buffer.description: Enable the use of a scratch buffer for DMA operations when reading sectors from the SD card. This buffer should be 512 bytes in size.

actions.message: Clear 'Disactivate all SD flags' to configure individual SD flags.

filex_mmc_flag_none.title: Disactivate all MMC flags
filex_mmc_flag_none.description: Disable all special flags for the MMC card operations. This is the default state with no additional features enabled.

filex_mmc_flag_cache_maintenance.title: Cache maintenance
filex_mmc_flag_cache_maintenance.description: Enable cache maintenance operations for the MMC card. This helps in ensuring data consistency and performance.

actions.message: Clear 'Disactivate all MMC flags' to configure individual MMC flags.

filex_mmc_flag_scratch_buffer.title: Scratch buffer
filex_mmc_flag_scratch_buffer.description: Enable the use of a scratch buffer for DMA operations when reading sectors from the MMC card. This buffer should be 512 bytes in size.

actions.message: Clear 'Disactivate all MMC flags' to configure individual MMC flags.

filex_nor_flag_none.title: Disactivate all NOR flash driver flags
filex_nor_flag_none.description: No special NOR flash driver flags enabled.

filex_nor_flag_format_on_init.title: Format NOR flash on initialization
filex_nor_flag_format_on_init.description: Activate formatting of the NOR flash memory during initialization.

actions.message: Clear 'Disactivate all NOR flash driver flags' to configure individual NOR flags.

filex_max_timeout.title: Maximum timeout
filex_max_timeout.description: This parameter defines the maximum timeout in milliseconds for a specific operation. The default value is 10,000 ms, which equals 10 seconds.

filex_driver_buffer.title: Define the driver buffer size
filex_driver_buffer.description: Define the FileX NAND driver working buffer size in ULONG elements. The default value 8192 corresponds to 32 KB when ULONG is 4 bytes.
